meta.homeTitle: Khondlo Tours — Ukuhamba ngezinyawo emaphandleni, amasafari nezimoto zokuthutha zisuka eHluhluwe
meta.homeDescription: Ukuvakashela imizana nomhlahlandlela, ukubuka izilwane eHluhluwe-iMfolozi, uhambo lwase-iSimangaliso, uhambo oluya eMozambique nezimoto zokuthutha ezisuka esikhumulweni zisuka eHluhluwe, KwaZulu-Natali. Abahlahlandlela bendawo, abashayeli abanamalayisensi.
meta.toursTitle: Uhambo olusuka eHluhluwe naseSt Lucia — amanani nokubhuka
meta.toursDescription: Ukuhamba emzaneni waseMacabuzela, ukubuka iziLwane Ezinhlanu eHluhluwe-iMfolozi, iSimangaliso Wetland Park, ukuhlangana nezindlovu, uhambo ngesikebhe lokubona izimvubu eSt Lucia nohambo lwezinsuku ezi-4 eMozambique. Amanani ngamaRandi.
meta.shuttlesTitle: Ukuthuthwa ezikhumulweni nasemikhunjini — King Shaka, OR Tambo, Richards Bay
meta.shuttlesDescription: Ukuthuthwa kusuka emnyango kuya emnyango phakathi kweHluhluwe, St Lucia nezikhumulo zezindiza iKing Shaka, i-OR Tambo neRichards Bay, kanye nokuthuthwa kuya etheminali yemikhumbi yaseRichards Bay. Izimoto zangasese nezamaqembu.
meta.aboutTitle: Mayelana neKhondlo Tours — inkampani yezokuvakasha nokuthutha yaseHluhluwe
meta.aboutDescription: IKhondlo Tours (Pty) Ltd yinkampani yendawo yohambo nokuthutha eHluhluwe, KwaZulu-Natali. Abahlahlandlela bendawo, abashayeli abanamalayisensi nokuvakasha okusekelwe emphakathini kusukela ngo-2016.
meta.galleryDescription: Ukuhamba emzaneni waseMacabuzela, ukuvakashela izikole, ukubuka izilwane nokuthuthwa — izithombe namavidiyo angempela ezivakashi zeKhondlo Tours.
meta.contactTitle: Xhumana nathi futhi ubhuke — Khondlo Tours, eHluhluwe
meta.contactDescription: Cela isilinganiso sentengo noma ubhuke uhambo noma imoto yokuthutha. Shaya ucingo noma u-WhatsApp ku-+27 82 663 6092, noma uthumele umbuzo ku-inthanethi.

common.priceNote: Amanani akumaRandi aseNingizimu Afrika futhi angashintsha ngokwenkathi nemali yokungena emapaki. Intengo yokugcina siyiqinisekisa uma ubhuka.

home.heroText: Ukuhamba emizaneni, ukubuka iziLwane Ezinhlanu, uhambo lwasemaxhaphozini nokuthuthwa kusuka emnyango kuya emnyango — kuhlelwa futhi kuholwa ithimba lendawo laseHluhluwe.
home.introTitle: Amaqembu amancane, abahlahlandlela bendawo, izindawo zangempela
home.introText: IKhondlo Tours yaqala eHluhluwe ngo-2016. Siyisa izivakashi emizini, ezikoleni nasemapulazini omphakathi wethu, emapaki ezilwane esakhulela eduze kwawo, futhi sikuyisa ngokuphepha sikubuyise.
home.introPoint1: Abahlahlandlela bale ndawo abazi umlando wayo nabantu bayo
home.introPoint2: Abashayeli abanamalayisensi namabhasi amancane, izimoto nama-SUV anakekelwe kahle
home.introPoint3: Ingxenye yohambo ngalunye emzaneni ibuyela emphakathini
home.toursText: Uhambo lwesigamu sosuku, losuku lonke nolwezinsuku eziningi olusuka eHluhluwe naseSt Lucia.
home.shuttleText: Sikulanda esikhumulweni sezindiza, etheminali yemikhumbi noma ehhotela bese sikuyisa KwaZulu — ngesikhathi, kunendawo yemithwalo yakho.
home.mozTitle: Izinsuku ezine ePonta do Ouro, eMozambique
home.mozText: Ulwandle, izimakethe zemizana, ukushayela ama-quad bike nokwehla ngezintambo — ukuwela umngcele eKosi Bay sikunakekela thina.
home.communityText: Siqasha futhi siqeqeshe abahlahlandlela nabashayeli bendawo, sithenga kubaqambi bezandla nakubalimi bendawo, futhi sihlela ukuvakashela izikole lapho izivakashi zihlangana khona nabafundi nothisha. Ukuvakasha lapha kufanele kushiye okuthile.
home.ctaText: Thumela izinsuku zakho nenani labantu, sizokuphendula ngesilinganiso sentengo esicacile.

tours.pageText: Uhambo ngalunye lufaka umhlahlandlela wendawo nokuthuthwa kusuka lapho uhlala khona eHluhluwe noma eSt Lucia. Ukulandwa ezindaweni ezikude kuhlawulwa ngokwehlukile.

macabuzela.name: Ukuhamba Ngezinyawo Emzaneni WaseMacabuzela
macabuzela.short: Hamba ezindleleni zaseMacabuzela nomhlahlandlela wendawo, uvakashele imizi yemindeni futhi ulalele izindaba ezidluliswe ezizukulwaneni ngezizukulwane.
macabuzela.intro: Lolu uhambo esiziqhenya ngalo kakhulu. Uhamba phakathi kwemizi ezindleleni zomhlabathi obomvu, ubuka amagquma, uhlangana nemindeni ehlala khona futhi ufunde ukuthi impilo yansuku zonke, ukudla namasiko kunjani emzaneni wamaZulu namuhla.
macabuzela.h4: Vakashela isikole sendawo noma ipulazi likaphayinaphu uma kuhlelwe kusengaphambili
macabuzela.h5: Imali yakho isekela imindeni namaphrojekthi owavakashelayo
macabuzela.know: Gqoka izicathulo ezivaliwe nesigqoko. Ukuhamba kuhamba kancane futhi kulungele abantu abaningi. Cela imvume ngaphambi kokuthwebula abantu — iningi livuma ngenjabulo.

hluhluwe.name: Ukubuka Izilwane eHluhluwe-iMfolozi
hluhluwe.short: Funa iziLwane Ezinhlanu egcekeni lezilwane elidala kunawo wonke e-Afrika, elake laba yindawo yokuzingela yeNkosi uShaka.
hluhluwe.intro: IHluhluwe-iMfolozi iyona kuphela ipaki kahulumeni KwaZulu-Natali enaziLwane Ezinhlanu zonke, futhi yaziwa ngobhejane abamhlophe nabamnyama. Umhlahlandlela wakho ufunda imikhondo futhi uyazazi izindawo zokuphuza amanzi.
hluhluwe.h1: Funa ibhubesi, ingwe, indlovu, inyathi nobhejane
hluhluwe.h3: Funda ukuthi ipaki yabusindisa kanjani ubhejane omhlophe
hluhluwe.know: Uhambo losuku lonke luqala ekuseni kakhulu, lapho izilwane zisebenza kakhulu. Phatha izibonakude, ingubo efudumele nesivikeli selanga.
hluhluwe.option1: Usuku lonke, nemali yokungena nesidlo sasemini
hluhluwe.option2: Isigamu sosuku, nemali yokungena nesidlo sasekuseni noma sasemini

isimangaliso.name: iSimangaliso Wetland Park
isimangaliso.short: Ulwandle, amachibi nehlathi lasogwini endaweni yeFa Lomhlaba — ukubhukuda ngesifihla-buso, ukubuka izinyoni noma uhambo lokushona kwelanga.
isimangaliso.intro: I-iSimangaliso ingenye yamapaki amakhulu asemaxhaphozini nasogwini e-Afrika. Khetha usuku lonke noma isigamu sosuku nokubhukuda ngesifihla-buso, uhambo oluthule lokushona kwelanga, noma ukubhukuda ngesifihla-buso noma ukubuka izinyoni kuphela.
isimangaliso.h2: Bona izimvubu, izingwenya namakhulu ezinhlobo zezinyoni
isimangaliso.h3: Buka ilanga lishona phezu komlomo womfula nokudla okulula newayini elibomvu
isimangaliso.h4: Imali yokungena ifakiwe kulo lonke uhambo lwasepaki
isimangaliso.know: Ukubhukuda ngesifihla-buso kuncike emagagasini nasesimweni solwandle — sihlela usuku ngokuya ngakho. Phatha izingubo zokubhukuda nethawula.
isimangaliso.option1: Usuku lonke, nemali yokungena, isidlo sasekuseni, sasemini nokubhukuda ngesifihla-buso
isimangaliso.option2: Isigamu sosuku, nemali yokungena, isidlo sasekuseni nokubhukuda ngesifihla-buso
isimangaliso.option3: Uhambo lokushona kwelanga, amahora ama-3, nemali yokungena, ukudla okulula newayini elibomvu

elephant.name: Ukuhlangana Nezindlovu
elephant.short: Ukuhlangana okufundisayo lapho uthinta futhi udlise uRambo noRachel, izindlovu ezimbili ezinakekelwa ngabagcini bazo.
elephant.intro: Hlangana noRambo noRachel eduze. Abagcini bazo bachaza ukuthi izindlovu ziphila kanjani, zidla kanjani futhi zixhumana kanjani, bese usiza ukuzidlisa ubhekiwe.
elephant.h3: Isidlo sasemini osikhethayo nokuthuthwa kokuya nokubuya kufakiwe
elephant.know: Izingane zamukelekile uma ziphelezelwa ngumuntu omdala. Landela iziyalezo zabagcini ngaso sonke isikhathi.
elephant.option1: Ukuhlangana, imali yokungena, isidlo sasemini nokuthuthwa

hippo.name: Uhambo Ngesikebhe Lokubona Izimvubu eSt Lucia
hippo.short: Amahora amabili emlonyeni womfula eSt Lucia, eduze kwemihlambi yezimvubu, izingwenya nezinyoni zasemanzini.
hippo.intro: Umlomo womfula eSt Lucia unenye yezinombolo ezinkulu kakhulu zezimvubu eNingizimu Afrika. Isikebhe sihamba kancane ngasogwini ukuze uzibuke futhi uzithwebule ngokuphepha.
hippo.know: Uhambo lwasekuseni nolwantambama lunokukhanya okuhle kakhulu. Izikhathi zesikebhe zincike kumsebenzisi waso.

mozambique.name: Uhambo Lwezinsuku Ezi-4 ePonta do Ouro, eMozambique
mozambique.short: Izinsuku zasolwandle, izimakethe zemizana, ama-quad bike nokwehla ngezintambo eningizimu yeMozambique, sinakekela ukuthutha nokuwela umngcele.
mozambique.intro: Sikushayela usuka eHluhluwe uwela umngcele eKosi Bay uye ePonta do Ouro. Uhlala ubusuku obuthathu e-Otia Hotel nesidlo sasekuseni nesakusihlwa, futhi uchitha izinsuku phakathi kolwandle, umzana nezindunduma zesihlabathi.
mozambique.d1: Ukuhamba ekuseni kakhulu, cishe amahora ama-5 kubalwa nokuwela umngcele eKosi Bay. Ukungena e-Otia Hotel, bese uya olwandle noma emakethe yendawo. Isidlo sakusihlwa ehhotela.
mozambique.d2: Uhambo nomhlahlandlela emzaneni wasePonta do Ouro nasezimakethe zemisebenzi yezandla. Intambama ekhululekile olwandle, ukubhukuda ngesifihla-buso uma uthanda. Isidlo sasekuseni nesakusihlwa.
mozambique.d3: Ekuseni ukushayela ama-quad bike ezindleleni zasogwini nasezindundumeni, ntambama ukwehla ngezintambo. Isikhathi samahhala sokuvakashela izindawo zokudlela. Isidlo sasekuseni nesakusihlwa.
mozambique.d4: Isidlo sasekuseni, ukuhamba kokugcina olwandle noma ukuthenga izikhumbuzo, bese kubuyelwa ekhaya. Ukufika eHluhluwe ntambama.
mozambique.inc2: Ubusuku obu-3 e-Otia Hotel, igumbi elihlanganyelwe
mozambique.inc3: Isidlo sasekuseni nesakusihlwa nsuku zonke (isidlo sakusihlwa kuze kufike ku-R200 umuntu ngamunye)
mozambique.exc4: Imali ye-visa, uma iphasiphothi yakho iyidinga
mozambique.know: Udinga iphasiphothi esasebenza okungenani izinyanga ezi-6. Intengo iyisilinganiso futhi ingashintsha ngokwenkathi, izinga lokushintshaniswa kwemali nokutholakala.

shuttles.pageText: Ukuthuthwa kusuka emnyango kuya emnyango phakathi kwaKwaZulu, izikhumulo zezindiza ezinkulu netheminali yemikhumbi yaseRichards Bay. Sithumelele imininingwane yendiza noma yomkhumbi wakho bese sihlela ukukulanda ngokuya ngayo.
shuttles.kingShaka: Isikhumulo Sezindiza Samazwe Ngamazwe iKing Shaka, eThekwini
shuttles.kingShakaText: Isikhumulo sezindiza samazwe ngamazwe saseThekwini. Cishe amahora angu-2.5 ukuya eHluhluwe noma eSt Lucia.
shuttles.orTambo: Isikhumulo Sezindiza Samazwe Ngamazwe i-OR Tambo, eGoli
shuttles.orTamboText: Uhambo losuku lonke olucishe lube ngamahora ama-7, kunokuma endleleni.
shuttles.richardsBayText: Isikhumulo esiseduze kakhulu neHluhluwe, cishe ihora eli-1 nemizuzu eyi-15.
shuttles.airstripsText: Sihlangabeza izindiza eziqashiwe futhi sixhumanisa amalodge, amahhotela namapaki ezilwane.
shuttles.cruiseText: Ukuthuthwa okuqondile phakathi kwetheminali yemikhumbi yethekwini laseRichards Bay neHluhluwe, St Lucia namapaki ezilwane — kuhlelwe ngokufika nokuhamba komkhumbi wakho. Izimoto zangasese noma amabhasi amancane amaqembu.
shuttles.fleetText: Amabhasi amancane anezihlalo ezi-10 kuya kwezingama-22 amaqembu nohambo, izimoto nama-SUV okuthutha kwangasese nokwebhizinisi, nezimoto zikanokusho zezivakashi ezikhethekile. Zonke zinabashayeli abanamalayisensi nokulandelelwa nge-GPS.
shuttles.how1: Thumela imininingwane yendiza noma yomkhumbi, ikheli lokukulanda nenani labagibeli.
shuttles.how3: Umshayeli wakho ukuhlangabeza ephethe ibhodi elinegama leKhondlo Tours.

about.pageText: IKhondlo Tours (Pty) Ltd isendaweni yaseNgonyamaneni eHluhluwe. Saqala ngo-2016 ukunikeza izivakashi uhambo oluphephile, olwethembekile nolunobuqotho KwaZulu-Natali — nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi abayivakashelayo iyazuza.
about.vision: Ukuba yinkampani yohambo nokuthutha ethenjwa kakhulu KwaZulu-Natali.
about.mission: Ukuxhumanisa abantu nobuhle, amasiko nomoya waKwaZulu-Natali ngohambo oluphephile, olunethezekile nolungalibaleki.
about.communityText: Siqasha futhi siqeqeshe abahlahlandlela nabashayeli bendawo, sisekela abaqambi bezandla namaphrojekthi amasiko endawo, sisebenzisana nezinhlelo zokuvakasha zomphakathi futhi sigcina uhambo lwethu lungalimazi imvelo.
about.whoText: Izivakashi zaseNingizimu Afrika nezaphesheya, amaqembu ezivakashi nabagibeli bemikhumbi, amabhizinisi, izikole namanyuvesi, abahleli bemicimbi, iminyango kahulumeni nezinhlangano ezingezona ezikahulumeni.
about.expoText: Sibamba iqhaza emibukisweni yezokuvakasha kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze sihlangane nama-ejensi ezokuvakasha, amahhotela nezivakashi ezintsha.

gallery.pageText: Izikhathi zangempela ohambweni lwethu — azikho izithombe ezithengwe kwenye indawo.

contact.pageText: Sitshele ukuthi ungathanda ukwenzani, sizokuphendula ngesilinganiso sentengo esicacile. I-WhatsApp iyindlela esheshayo yokusithola.
contact.hours: Ukushaya ucingo noma ukuthumela umlayezo ku-WhatsApp kuyindlela esheshayo yokusithola.
contact.name: Igama lakho
contact.messageHint: Indawo yokukulanda, inombolo yendiza, uhambo olufunayo — noma yini esisiza ukulinganisa intengo.
contact.success: Siyabonga. Umbuzo wakho uthunyelwe futhi sizoxhumana nawe maduze.
contact.error: Umbuzo wakho awuthunyelwanga. Sicela uzame futhi, noma uxhumane nathi ku-WhatsApp.
contact.errMessage: Sitshele kancane ngohambo lwakho (okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-10).
contact.privacy: Imininingwane yakho siyisebenzisela kuphela ukuphendula umbuzo wakho.

notFound.title: Le ndlela ayiholeli ndawo
notFound.text: Kungenzeka ukuthi ikhasi lithuthiwe. Zama ikhasi lohambo noma ubuyele ekhaya.
